ruleDefinitions.name: Potential 7za.DLL Sideloading
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential DLL sideloading of "7za.dll" Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\7za\\\.dll$") AND  NOT (((process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\")) AND (ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\"))))
